## Power Sessions 0.1.5

Chat sessions get their own button in the Sessions list, and Stop works for quick action servers started by hand in an Orca terminal.

- A chat session's button shows a chat bubble instead of a terminal. It still shows the chat's tab in Orca.
- A quick action whose server was started by hand in an Orca terminal now shows Stop and Show terminal, found from the server's port.
- Stop never closes an agent's terminal, even when an agent started the server.
